environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway HTTP API with default configuration. Lambda has 512MB memory, 30s timeout. API Gateway has no rate limiting, no request validation, and passes all responses including headers directly to client. CloudWatch logging enabled but no alerting configured. Lambda execution role has basic AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API, no throttling, no request validation
config.response_headers: all headers passed through including X-Decrypt-Time
